changes.summary: First published bulk schema. One gzipped CSV per frozen vintage week. Columns are the town and province rows already in that vintage, with the capture date and ISO week repeated on each row. An empty cell is a null on the vintage row. A week with no frozen vintage has no file. Parquet is not part of schema 1.

columns.name: vintage_date
columns.description: Capture date of the frozen vintage: the last eligible public/data.json commit in that closed ISO week. Repeated on every row so weeks can be concatenated.

columns.name: iso_week
columns.description: ISO week of the capture date, Monday to Sunday, UTC.

columns.name: week_start
columns.description: Monday of that ISO week, UTC.

columns.name: week_end
columns.description: Sunday of that ISO week, UTC.

columns.name: level
columns.description: province or town. Copied from the vintage row.

columns.name: key
columns.description: Province key or town name, copied from the vintage row.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Display name, copied from the vintage row.

columns.name: province
columns.description: Province name on a town row. Empty on a province row. Copied from the vintage row.

columns.name: costa
columns.description: Costa label, copied from the vintage row. Empty when the vintage left it empty.

columns.name: live_listings
columns.description: Listings in that place on the capture date. A listing is one feed reference, not one dwelling.

columns.name: priced_listings
columns.description: Listings in that place with a positive asking EUR per square metre.

columns.name: median_asking_eur_m2
columns.description: Median asking EUR per square metre, copied from the vintage row. Empty when the vintage published no median. No value is filled in from another day.

columns.name: comparable_listings
columns.description: Same ref and same place with a positive asking price in this vintage and the previous one. Empty when there is no previous vintage.

columns.name: price_cuts
columns.description: Comparable listings with a lower asking price on the capture date. Empty when there is no previous vintage.

columns.name: price_rises
columns.description: Comparable listings with a higher asking price on the capture date. Empty when there is no previous vintage.

columns.name: price_cut_share
columns.description: price_cuts divided by comparable listings, the decimal string already on the vintage row. Empty when the vintage left it empty.

columns.name: price_rise_share
columns.description: price_rises divided by the same comparable count, the decimal string already on the vintage row. Empty when the vintage left it empty.

columns.name: new_listings
columns.description: A ref in this place on the capture date that was not in the previous book. Empty when there is no previous vintage.

columns.name: removed_listings
columns.description: A ref that was in this place in the previous vintage and is absent from the whole book on the capture date. Leaving the book is not a recorded sale. Empty when there is no previous vintage.

columns.name: reassigned_in
columns.description: A ref present in both books that moved into this place. Empty when there is no previous vintage.

columns.name: reassigned_out
columns.description: A ref present in both books that moved out of this place. Empty when there is no previous vintage.
